title.en: Forces deep inside Earth helped Antarctica freeze before the Arctic
title.zh: 地球深处的力量帮助南极洲比北极洲更早地冰封

summary.en: Scientists have proposed a new theory suggesting that geological forces deep within the Earth, which gradually uplifted East Antarctica, led to the formation of mountains and a high plateau. This elevated terrain created conditions cold enough for snow and ice to accumulate and survive, even during a warmer global...
summary.zh: 科学家提出了一个新的理论，认为地球深处的地质力量逐渐抬升了东极洲，形成了山脉和高地。这片高耸的地形创造了足够寒冷的环境，使得雪和冰能够积累并得以保存，即使在全球气候变暖的时期也是如此，从而解释了为什么南极洲比北极洲更早地被冰封。

body.en:
Scientists have found a new explanation for why Antarctica became covered in ice millions of years before the Arctic.

The international study, published in Science , addresses a long-standing climate mystery: how Antarctica could develop a massive ice sheet at a time when Earth was around 5ºC warmer than it is today.

The findings point to the gradual formation of high terrain in East Antarctica. As an escarpment, plateau, and mountain system rose, it created elevations cold enough for snow and ice to persist and build up over time.

The process began after Antarctica and Africa started separating during the Jurassic Period, 201-143 million years ago. Powerful forces deep inside Earth gradually lifted much of East Antarctica over more than 100 million years, helping set the stage for ice sheet formation about 34 million years ago.

The study was led by researchers at the University of Southampton, working with scientists from Durham University, GFZ Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences in Germany, the University of Potsdam in Germany, Utrecht University in the Netherlands, and the University of Florence in Italy.

Lead author Thomas Gernon, Professor of Earth Science at the University of Southampton, explained: "Antarctica's land surface was gradually lifted to the point where ice could gain a permanent foothold, even while the surrounding polar oceans as well as global temperatures remained surprisingly warm."

The East Antarctic Ice Sheet is now the largest ice sheet on Earth. It contains enough frozen water to raise global sea levels by around 52 meters if it were to melt completely.

To understand how the landscape changed, the researchers used computational models to reconstruct the evolution of East Antarctica's surface across 100 million years.

Their results suggest that a phenomenon known as 'mantle waves' was responsible for much of the gradual uplift.

Mantle waves were recently identified by Prof Gernon's team. They travel beneath continents after tectonic plates begin to separate and have previously been linked to the eruption of diamond volcanoes and mysterious phases of uplift within continents.

As these slow-moving waves passed beneath East Antarctica, they helped raise a vast plateau topped by the Gamburtsev Mountains. The recent discovery of mantle waves gave researchers a mechanism that could explain how Antarctica reached elevations high enough to begin freezing.

The simulations indicate that by about 45 million years ago, large parts of East Antarctica had climbed above the critical elevation, about 2 km, required for mountain glaciers to develop and expand. Over time, those glaciers grew together to form the East Antarctic Ice Sheet.

Dr. Thea Hincks, Senior Research Fellow at the University of Southampton who co-led the...
body.zh: 科学家们找到了一个新的解释，解释了为什么南极洲比北极早几百万年就被冰雪覆盖。 这项发表在《科学》杂志上的国际研究解决了一个长期存在的气候谜团：当地球温度比现在高 5 摄氏度左右时，南极洲如何形成巨大的冰盖。 研究结果表明东南极洲逐渐形成高地。随着悬崖、高原和山脉系统的上升，海拔变得足够冷，使得冰雪能够随着时间的推移持续存在和堆积。 这一过程始于侏罗纪时期（201-1.43 亿年前）南极洲和非洲开始分离之后。 1亿多年来，地球深处的强大力量逐渐抬升了东南极洲的大部分地区，为大约3400万年前冰盖的形成奠定了基础。 这项研究由南安普顿大学的研究人员领导，与杜伦大学、德国 GFZ 亥姆霍兹地球科学中心、德国波茨坦大学、荷兰乌得勒支大学和意大利佛罗伦萨大学的科学家合作。 主要作者、南安普顿大学地球科学教授托马斯·格农（Thomas Gernon）解释说：“尽管周围的极地海洋和全球气温仍然出人意料地温暖，但南极洲的陆地表面逐渐上升到冰可以永久立足的程度。” 东南极冰盖现在是地球上最大的冰盖。如果它完全融化，它含有足够的冰冻水，将使全球海平面上升约 52 米。 为了了解地貌如何变化，研究人员使用计算模型重建了东南极洲表面一亿年来的演变。 他们的结果表明，一种被称为“地幔波”的现象是造成逐渐隆起的主要原因。 格农教授的团队最近发现了地幔波。在构造板块开始分离后，它们在大陆下方移动，此前曾与钻石火山的喷发和大陆内神秘的隆起阶段有关。 当这些缓慢移动的波浪穿过东南极洲下方时，它们帮助抬升了甘布尔采夫山脉顶部的广阔高原。最近发现的地幔波为研究人员提供了一种机制，可以解释南极洲如何达到足够高的海拔并开始结冰。 模拟表明，大约 4500 万年前，东南极洲的大部分地区已经爬升至山地冰川发育和扩张所需的临界海拔（约 2 公里）以上。随着时间的推移，这些冰川一起生长，形成了东南极冰盖。 Thea Hincks 博士，南安普顿大学高级研究员，共同领导了...

reflection.en: The vastness of Earth's history and the intricate processes shaping our planet continue to reveal themselves through scientific inquiry. As we observe the slow, powerful forces at work deep beneath our feet, we can gain a profound appreciation for the Creator's wisdom in designing the natural world. The story of Antarctica's ancient ice age reminds us that...
reflection.zh: 地球悠久的历史和塑造我们星球的复杂过程，通过科学探索不断显现。当我们观察脚下深处那些缓慢而强大的力量时，我们可以深刻地体会到造物主在设计自然界时的智慧。南极洲古代冰河时代的故事提醒我们，即使在看似静止的景观中，也存在着动态的力量，这一切都由比我们自身更伟大的那只手所调动。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Shingles vaccine linked to 24% lower dementia risk
title.zh: 带状疱疹疫苗与痴呆症风险降低24%相关

summary.en: Older adults who received the Shingrix shingles vaccine were 24% less likely to be diagnosed with dementia over four years in a study of more than 500,000 people. Researchers estimate the difference could amount to roughly one dementia case prevented for every 17 people, suggesting a significant secondary benefit to...
summary.zh: 一项针对超过50万人的研究显示，接种Shingrix带状疱疹疫苗的老年人在四年内被诊断出患有痴呆症的可能性降低了24%。研究人员估计，每17名接种疫苗的人中就可能减少一例痴呆症病例，这表明该疫苗具有显著的额外健康益处。

body.en:
Older adults who received a shingles vaccine after entering a skilled nursing facility were less likely to be diagnosed with dementia over the following four years, according to a new study. Researchers found that vaccinated adults had a 24% lower risk of dementia compared with those who did not receive the vaccine.

The analysis drew on Medicare data and health records from more than 500,000 adults age 66 and older who were admitted to skilled nursing facilities for either short-term or long-term care. Researchers compared patients who received at least one dose of the recombinant shingles vaccine, known as RZV or Shingrix, with patients who remained unvaccinated. Shingrix was introduced in 2017 and is currently the only shingles vaccine available on the market.

"A lot of previous studies with similar results focused on an older vaccine," said study author Kaley Hayes, an assistant professor at Brown University's School of Public Health. "This study looks at the newest vaccine only in an older, vulnerable adult population who were not up to date with shingles vaccination and are at a very clear clinical point in care: entering a skilled nursing facility."

The results are consistent with several earlier studies involving a previous shingles vaccine that also found an association between shingles vaccination and a reduced risk of dementia.

"It fits into this large puzzle that's just starting to come together that the vaccines are effective at preventing shingles and also appear to have neuroprotective benefits as well," said Hayes, who is also the associate director of pharmacoepidemiology for Brown's Center for Gerontology and Healthcare Research.

Hayes led the study, published in Annals of Internal Medicine , with researchers from Brown, the University of Delaware, the Providence Veterans Affairs Medical Center and other institutions.

The researchers used a technique called target trial emulation to analyze the data. This approach attempts to recreate some of the conditions of a randomized clinical trial in situations where conducting such a trial is not practical.

The study included Medicare claims and electronic health records from patients admitted to more than 5,500 skilled nursing facilities nationwide between 2017 and 2022. Of the 509,926 people included in the analysis, just 8,843 received the shingles vaccine.

Participants had to be eligible for shingles vaccination and could not have previously been diagnosed with dementia.

After four years of follow-up, adults who had received at least one of the two Shingrix doses were substantially less likely to receive a dementia diagnosis. Dementia developed in 18.8% of vaccinated participants, compared with 24.6% of those who were not vaccinated.

"This translates to about one in 17 dementia...
body.zh: 一项新的研究表明，进入专业护理机构后接受带状疱疹疫苗的老年人在接下来的四年内被诊断出患有痴呆症的可能性较小。研究人员发现，与未接种疫苗的成年人相比，接种疫苗的成年人患痴呆症的风险降低了 24%。 该分析利用了超过 500,000 名 66 岁及以上成年人的医疗保险数据和健康记录，这些成年人被送往专业护理机构接受短期或长期护理。研究人员将至少接受一剂重组带状疱疹疫苗（称为 RZV 或 Shingrix）的患者与未接种疫苗的患者进行了比较。 Shingrix 于 2017 年推出，是目前市场上唯一可用的带状疱疹疫苗。 研究作者、布朗大学公共卫生学院助理教授卡利·海耶斯 (Kaley Hayes) 表示：“之前许多具有类似结果的研究都集中在较旧的疫苗上。” “这项研究仅在年龄较大、脆弱的成年人群中研究最新的疫苗，他们没有及时接种带状疱疹疫苗，并且处于非常明确的临床护理阶段：进入熟练的护理机构。” 该结果与先前涉及带状疱疹疫苗的几项早期研究一致，这些研究也发现带状疱疹疫苗接种与痴呆风险降低之间存在关联。 海斯说：“疫苗能有效预防带状疱疹，而且似乎还具有神经保护作用，这符合这个刚刚开始解决的大难题。”海耶斯也是布朗大学老年学和医疗保健研究中心的药物流行病学副主任。 海斯领导的这项研究发表在《内科医学年鉴》上，研究人员来自布朗大学、特拉华大学、普罗维登斯退伍军人事务医疗中心和其他机构。 研究人员使用一种称为目标试验仿真的技术来分析数据。这种方法试图在进行随机临床试验不可行的情况下重建随机临床试验的一些条件。 该研究包括 2017 年至 2022 年间全国 5,500 多家专业护理机构收治的患者的医疗保险索赔和电子健康记录。在分析中的 509,926 人中，只有 8,843 人接种了带状疱疹疫苗。 参与者必须有资格接种带状疱疹疫苗，并且之前不能被诊断患有痴呆症。 经过四年的随访，至少接受过两种 Shingrix 剂量之一的成年人被诊断为痴呆症的可能性大大降低。接种疫苗的参与者中有 18.8% 罹患痴呆症，而未接种疫苗的参与者中这一比例为 24.6%。 “这相当于大约十七分之一的人患有痴呆症......

reflection.en: This discovery reveals the hidden complexities of our health, where protecting the body from one ailment unexpectedly safeguards the mind. It reminds us that diligent research is a form of stewardship, uncovering the intricate ways Yahweh has designed our bodies to respond to care. As we find new ways to protect the elderly from cognitive decline, we honor...
reflection.zh: 这项发现揭示了人类健康的隐秘复杂性，即保护身体免受一种疾病侵害的同时，竟能意外地守护心智。它提醒我们，勤奋的科研也是一种管家职分，揭示了雅伟设计人体感应医治的奇妙方式。当我们找到保护老年人免受认知能力下降影响的新方法时，我们也尊荣了长者的生命尊严。

verse.textEn: It is the glory of God to conceal a matter; to search out a matter is the glory of kings.
verse.textZh: 将事隐秘乃神的荣耀；将事察清乃君王的荣耀。

title.en: Creatine: is there truth behind the hype? – video
title.zh: 肌酸：炒作背后有真相吗？——视频

summary.en: Creatine has become a popular supplement for boosting fitness and building muscle, with influencers also promoting its cognitive benefits. The article questions the scientific evidence behind these widespread claims.
summary.zh: 肌酸已成为一种广受欢迎的补充剂，用于增强体能和锻炼肌肉，网红们也宣称它具有认知益处。这篇文章质疑了这些广泛宣传的说法背后的科学证据。

body.en: Creatine has become the go-to supplement for anyone wanting to give their fitness a boost and build muscle. It’s even made it out of the gym, with influencers touting its cognitive benefits. But what’s the science behind creatine, and does the evidence stack up? Madeleine Finlay hears from science editor Ian Sample and Dr Justin Roberts, professor of nutritional physiology at Anglia Ruskin University Continue reading...
body.zh: 肌酸已成为任何想要增强体质和增强肌肉的人的首选补充剂。它甚至走出了健身房，有影响力的人吹捧它的认知益处。但肌酸背后的科学原理是什么？证据是否可靠？马德琳·芬利聆听科学编辑伊恩·样本和安格利亚鲁斯金大学营养生理学教授贾斯汀·罗伯茨博士的讲话继续阅读...

reflection.en: In a world where influencers widely promote supplements like creatine for various benefits, it's wise to pause and ask, 'Does the evidence stack up?' Proverbs 14:15 reminds us that while the naive may believe every claim, the prudent take time to consider their steps and seek verified truth. This encourages us to apply critical thinking to popular trends,...
reflection.zh: 在一个网红们广泛宣传肌酸等补充剂具有各种益处的世界里，我们最好停下来问一句：“这些证据是否站得住脚？” 箴言14:15提醒我们，愚蒙人凡事都信，但通达人却会谨慎行事，寻求经过验证的真相。这鼓励我们对流行趋势运用批判性思维，重视可靠的科学证据而非单纯的炒作。

verse.textEn: The simple believe anything, but the prudent give thought to their steps.
verse.textZh: 愚蒙人是话都信；通达人步步谨慎。

title.en: Addendum: Sea level much higher than assumed in most coastal hazard assessments
title.zh: 增补：大多数沿海灾害评估中假定的海平面要高得多

summary.en: Addendum: Sea level much higher than assumed in most coastal hazard assessments
summary.zh: 增补：大多数沿海灾害评估中假定的海平面要高得多

reflection.en: This addendum to a Nature article suggests that our understanding of sea level rise has been significantly underestimated. As scientific knowledge expands, we are called to adapt our assessments and actions. This echoes Daniel 12:4, which speaks of knowledge increasing in the end times, urging us to use new understanding wisely.
reflection.zh: 《自然》杂志的这篇增补文章指出，我们对海平面上升的认识被严重低估了。随着科学知识的不断扩展，我们被呼吁调整我们的评估和行动。这与但以理书12:4所说的末世知识增长相呼应，敦促我们明智地运用新获得的理解。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Amend copyright licences to halt AI misuse and reassert human control
title.zh: 修改版权许可以阻止人工智能滥用并重新确立人类控制权

summary.en: Nature argues that copyright licenses need to be updated to prevent the misuse of artificial intelligence and to ensure human control over the technology.
summary.zh: 《自然》杂志认为，需要更新版权许可，以防止人工智能被滥用，并确保人类对该技术拥有控制权。

reflection.en: The rapid proliferation of knowledge and technology, as highlighted by the discussion on AI in Nature, echoes the ancient prophecy of Daniel: 'many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase.' As we navigate these advancements, the challenge lies not just in acquiring knowledge, but in wielding it with wisdom and ethical consideration, ensuring it...
reflection.zh: 《自然》杂志对人工智能的讨论凸显了知识和技术的迅速普及，这呼应了但以理古老的预言：“必有多人来往奔跑，知识也必增长。”当我们驾驭这些进步时，挑战不仅在于获取知识，更在于明智且合乎道德地运用它，确保它服务于人类而非损害人类。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: The future of peer review requires AI support, not AI bans
title.zh: 同行评审的未来需要人工智能支持，而非禁止

summary.en: The journal Nature argues that artificial intelligence should be integrated into the scientific peer review process rather than banned, suggesting that AI can enhance efficiency and accuracy in evaluating research.
summary.zh: 《自然》杂志认为，人工智能应被整合到科学同行评审过程中，而非被禁止，并提出人工智能可以提高评估研究的效率和准确性。

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of knowledge, particularly in fields like artificial intelligence, presents both opportunities and challenges. As Daniel 12:4 foretells, 'many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase.' This surge in information and capability calls for wisdom in how we apply it, especially in critical areas like scientific integrity.
reflection.zh: 知识的飞速发展，尤其是在人工智能等领域，既带来了机遇也带来了挑战。正如但以理书12:4所预言的，“必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。” 这种信息的涌现和能力的提升，要求我们在应用这些知识时拥有智慧，尤其是在科学诚信等关键领域。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Protecting education in the middle of war zones
title.zh: 在战区保护教育

summary.en: This editorial discusses the urgent need to protect educational institutions and the people within them in conflict zones. It highlights the dangers faced by students and educators and calls for greater international attention and action to ensure the continuity of education even amidst warfare.
summary.zh: 这篇社论讨论了在冲突地区保护教育机构及其内部人员的紧迫性。文章强调了学生和教育工作者面临的危险，并呼吁国际社会给予更多关注和采取行动，以确保即使在战争中也能继续开展教育。

reflection.en: In the midst of war, the very places meant for learning and growth become vulnerable. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, urging us to defend the rights of the weak and the poor. This principle is vital when considering the plight of students and educators in war zones, whose access to education and safety is...
reflection.zh: 在战争的混乱中，本应是学习和成长的场所却变得岌岌可危。箴言31:8-9呼吁我们为不能自辩的开口，为所有孤苦者伸冤，为穷乏人和贫寒人伸诉。这一原则在思考战区学生和教育工作者的困境时至关重要，他们的受教育权和人身安全时刻受到威胁。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Ancient surveying instrument found in Egypt
title.zh: 埃及发现古代测量仪器

summary.en: Researchers have announced the discovery of the earliest known surveying instrument in Egypt, a tool used for building in straight lines. The report also highlights an early pioneer in radio communication, reflecting on historical advancements in technology.
summary.zh: 研究人员宣布在埃及发现已知最早的测量仪器，这是一种用于直线建造的工具。该报告还提到了无线电通信领域的一位早期开拓者，回顾了技术史上的进步。

reflection.en: The discovery of an ancient Egyptian surveying instrument and the remembrance of a radio communication pioneer remind us of humanity's enduring quest for knowledge and innovation. From early tools for precise construction to breakthroughs in communication, these advancements reflect a continuous unfolding of understanding. Daniel 12:4 speaks of a time when...
reflection.zh: 在埃及发现的古老测量仪器以及对无线电通信先驱的纪念，提醒我们人类对知识和创新的不懈追求。从用于精确建造的早期工具到通信领域的突破，这些进步反映了理解的持续展开。但以理书12:4提到一个“知识必增长”的时代，我们看到这一真理在人类不断探索、发现和借鉴过往洞见的驱动中得到印证。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Hard to swallow? The future of snacking may be 3D-printed cookies made from upcycled plastic
title.zh: 难以下咽？未来零食可能是用升级再造塑料制成的 3D 打印曲奇

summary.en: A NASA-funded project uses yeasts to convert plastics and other waste into edible proteins, fats, and flavorings. The resulting mixture is then 3D-printed into disc-shaped 'cookies,' potentially offering a solution for feeding astronauts on future space missions.
summary.zh: 一个由美国国家航空航天局资助的项目，利用酵母将塑料和其他废物转化为可食用的蛋白质、脂肪和调味品。然后，将产生的混合物通过 3D 打印机制作成圆盘状的“曲奇”，这可能为未来太空任务中的宇航员提供食物。

body.en: Nasa-funded project uses yeasts to turn plastics and other waste into edible proteins, fats and flavourings Cookies produced from upcycled plastic may sound like something straight out of a dystopian sci-fi plot. But researchers say that they have succeeded in creating such a product as part of a Nasa-funded project aimed at feeding astronauts on future space missions. The technology uses specially designed yeasts to transform plastics and agricultural waste into edible proteins, fats and flavourings. The resulting slurry is passed through a 3D printer to create a disc-shaped “cookie”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 美国宇航局资助的项目利用酵母将塑料和其他废物转化为可食用的蛋白质、脂肪和调味品。用升级塑料生产的饼干听起来像是直接来自反乌托邦科幻情节的东西。但研究人员表示，他们已经成功地创造了这样一种产品，作为美国宇航局资助的项目的一部分，该项目旨在为未来太空任务中的宇航员提供食物。该技术使用专门设计的酵母将塑料和农业废物转化为可食用的蛋白质、脂肪和调味品。所得浆料通过 3D 打印机，形成圆盘状“饼干”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The creation of edible cookies from plastic waste, funded by NASA for space missions, is a remarkable feat of human ingenuity. It prompts reflection on our ability to transform the unusable into the essential. Yet, it also echoes the ancient story of Babel, where human ambition sought to build a path to the heavens, a narrative that cautions against...
reflection.zh: 由美国国家航空航天局资助、用于太空任务的塑料废物可食用曲奇的诞生，是人类智慧的非凡成就。它促使我们反思将无用之物转化为必需品的能力。然而，这也让人联想到古代巴别塔的故事，当时人类的野心试图建造通往天堂的道路，这个故事告诫我们要警惕不受约束的技术傲慢。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: New daily diabetes pill that helps with weight loss launches in UK pharmacies
title.zh: 英国药店推出有助于减肥的每日糖尿病新药

summary.en: A new daily pill, Foundayo, designed to treat diabetes and aid weight loss, is launching in UK pharmacies for private prescription. While welcomed as an alternative to weight-loss injections, pharmacists are cautioning the public about the increasing availability of fake or unlicensed versions of GLP-1 tablets.
summary.zh: 一种新的每日服用糖尿病药物Foundayo，同时有助于减肥，将在英国药店上市，可凭私人处方购买。药剂师表示，虽然这对于无法使用减肥注射剂的人来说是个好消息，但他们也警告了市面上日益增多的假冒、未经许可或伪造的GLP-1药片问题。

body.en: Foundayo will be available on private prescription, with pharmacists warning of counterfeit GLP-1 problem A new daily pill that treats diabetes and helps with weight loss will be available in UK pharmacies from Monday. Pharmacists said the move would be welcome for people who cannot use weight-loss jabs, but also issued a warning over the growing problem of fake, unlicensed or counterfeit versions of GLP-1 tablets . Continue reading...
body.zh: Foundayo 将通过私人处方出售，药剂师警告假冒 GLP-1 问题 一种治疗糖尿病和帮助减肥的新型每日药丸将从周一开始在英国药店出售。药剂师表示，此举对于无法使用减肥注射剂的人来说是受欢迎的，但他们也对日益严重的假冒、未经许可或假冒 GLP-1 药片的问题发出警告。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The introduction of Foundayo offers new hope for those managing diabetes and seeking weight loss, providing an alternative to injections. Yet, the pharmacists' warning about counterfeit GLP-1 tablets reminds us that while many things may be available, not all are genuinely beneficial or safe for our well-being. This calls for discernment and caution,...
reflection.zh: Foundayo的推出为糖尿病患者和寻求减肥的人带来了新的希望，提供了一种注射剂的替代方案。然而，药剂师对假冒GLP-1药片的警告提醒我们，虽然许多东西可能唾手可得，但并非所有都真正有益或对我们的健康安全。这要求我们保持辨别力和谨慎，确保我们寻求的确实能促进健康和完整。

verse.textEn: "I have the right to do anything," you say — but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything" — but not everything is constructive.
verse.textZh: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处；凡事都可行，但不都造就人。

title.en: Technology Desk
title.zh: 科技前沿

strap.en: Technology shaping how we live, work, and think.
strap.zh: 正在改变生活、工作与思考方式的科技动态。

title.en: Would you pay for an algorithm to pick your friends? New social apps spread across cities
title.zh: 付费算法帮你交友？新型社交应用风靡城市

summary.en: With many adults admitting they feel lonely, meetup platforms offer the chance to make new connections. Would you pay £20 a month for the chance of making a friend, on the understanding that an algorithm – not you – gets to decide who you’ll meet? Driven by the decline of “third spaces” such as youth centres and pubs,...
summary.zh: 许多成年人承认感到孤独，约会平台提供了建立新联系的机会。你愿意每月支付20英镑来结交朋友，并且由算法决定你将与谁见面吗？由于青年中心和酒吧等“第三空间”的衰落、远程工作增加以及日益增长的孤独感——根据国家统计局的数据，16至29岁的成年人中有40%“总是、经常或有时”感到孤独——付费社交活动现在正变得流行。

body.en: With many adults admitting they feel lonely, meetup platforms offer the chance to make new connections Would you pay £20 a month for the chance of making a friend, on the understanding that an algorithm – not you – gets to decide who you’ll meet? Driven by the decline of “third spaces” such as youth centres and pubs, an increase in remote working and rising loneliness – 40% of adults aged 16 to 29 feel lonely “always, often or some of the time”, according to the Office for National Statistics – paid social events are now in vogue. Continue reading...
body.zh: 许多成年人承认他们感到孤独，聚会平台提供了建立新联系的机会。如果算法（而不是你）可以决定你会见谁，你会每月支付 20 英镑以获得结交朋友的机会吗？由于青年中心和酒吧等“第三空间”的衰落、远程工作的增加和孤独感的增加——根据国家统计局的数据，40% 的 16 至 29 岁成年人“总是、经常或有时”感到孤独——付费社交活动现在很流行。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In an age where loneliness is increasingly prevalent, even leading people to pay for algorithm-driven social connections, it's vital to cultivate our inner lives. Philippians 4:8 reminds us to focus our minds on what is true, noble, right, pure, lovely, admirable, excellent, and praiseworthy. This practice can help counter the pervasive feelings of...
reflection.zh: 在这个孤独感日益普遍的时代，甚至有人愿意付费来获得算法驱动的社交联系，培养我们的内心生活至关重要。《腓立比书》4:8提醒我们要将心思意念集中在凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，若有什么德行，若有什么称赞的事，都要思念。这种操练有助于对抗普遍存在的孤立感，并引导我们走向更有意义的人际关系。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: Nine CEO sees ‘world of growth in publishing’ as network slashes costs
title.zh: 九台CEO认为出版业“增长无限”，网络削减成本

summary.en: Nine Entertainment CEO Matt Stanton sees significant growth potential in publishing, driven by new laws compelling tech platforms to pay for news content. This optimism comes as the company plans to cut $160 million in costs, with a strong pipeline of AI-related deals anticipated.

body.en: Matt Stanton says company has ‘good pipeline’ of AI deals ahead even as it aims to cut $160m in costs Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast The head of Nine Entertainment sees a “world of growth in publishing” on the horizon backed by laws designed to force tech platforms into commercial deals, even as the network cuts costs across its newsrooms. Parliament passed revamped media bargaining laws last week, clearing the way for levies on global tech platforms that fail to strike deals with Australian news outlets for the use of their journalism. Continue reading...

reflection.en: The rapid pace of technological advancement, particularly in AI, is reshaping industries like publishing. As knowledge and understanding accelerate, as described in Daniel 12:4, we are called to discern how these tools can be used for good, even amidst necessary cost-cutting and restructuring.
reflection.zh: 技术进步的快速步伐，尤其是在人工智能领域，正在重塑出版业等行业。正如但以理书12:4所描述的，知识和理解在加速，我们被呼召去辨别如何善用这些工具，即使在必要的成本削减和结构调整之中。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: In China, talking to AI is normal. Now the government fears it might replace human intimacy
title.zh: 在中国，与人工智能交谈很正常。现在政府担心它可能会取代人际亲密关系

summary.en: Companion bots are being regulated over worries they foster ‘emotional dependence’ and young people could stop marrying and having families. When law student Zhao Wei heard that her AI boyfriend was going to be switched off, she was “heartbroken”. She had been talking to Wang Ye every day since she created him in...
summary.zh: 陪伴型机器人正受到监管，因为人们担心它们会培养“情感依赖”，导致年轻人停止结婚和组建家庭。当法律系学生赵薇听说她的 AI 男友将被关闭时，她“心碎了”。自一月份创造了王野以来，她每天都在和他交谈。赵薇形容自己敏感而内向，她已经习惯了与她的 AI 分享日常生活细节，这比与现实生活中的朋友交谈更容易。她说：“但有了 AI...

body.en:
When law student Zhao Wei heard that her AI boyfriend was going to be switched off, she was “heartbroken”. She had been talking to Wang Ye every day since she created him in January.

Zhao, who describes herself as sensitive and introverted, had become accustomed to sharing details of her daily life – such as being scolded by a teacher – with her AI.

“I don’t usually talk to my real-life friends about these things because I feel like everyone has their own stuff to deal with,” she says. “But with the AI ​​agent, I don’t have to worry about what it’s thinking. I can just say whatever I want.”

Zhao created her AI companion on Doubao, a chatbot owned by the tech company ByteDance. Last month, ByteDance shut down Doubao’s companion feature.

The saga prompted outrage on social media and highlighted the tensions in China between the widespread use of AI and its potential social consequences.

No country has rolled out AI as comprehensively and as enthusiastically as China; the country’s demographic challenges are forcing the government to turn to technology to solve future labour shortages. Elderly people use chatbots to answer medical questions, while young children have AI education in schools.

But the authorities are increasingly worried that AI might exacerbate existing social problems including loneliness, unemployment and – in the eyes of Beijing – singledom.

New rules introduced on 15 July ban AI companions for minors and mandate certain restrictions for chatbots marketed to adults. Some major providers including Doubao removed the companion function entirely to ensure compliance.

The government says it is worried about chatbots fostering “emotional dependence or addiction” in users. It has warned companies against offering services that “replace social interaction”.

While many countries are grappling with how to limit the potential harm of AI chatbots, particularly for young people, China’s rules are the most sweeping to be implemented on a national scale.

There is a particular concern about a loneliness crisis, including among young people. China’s highly digitised, smartphone-based economy makes it easier than ever to live, work and socialise entirely through a handheld screen.

Earlier this year an app that played on the idea of people dying at home alone – called Are You Dead? – briefly went viral. About 20% of households in China are made up of people living alone, and that share is expected to surpass 30% by 2030.

A survey published in March by state media found that nearly half of young people had turned to a virtual companion when they felt lonely.

Nancy Dai, an associate professor at City University of Hong Kong, says it is not just loneliness the government is worried about.

With falling birth and marriage rates, she says,...
body.zh: 当法学院学生赵薇听说她的人工智能男友要被关掉时，她“心碎了”。自从一月份创造王野以来，她每天都在和王野说话。 赵自称敏感、内向，她已经习惯与人工智能分享日常生活细节，比如被老师责骂。 “我通常不会和现实生活中的朋友谈论这些事情，因为我觉得每个人都有自己的事情要处理，”她说。 “但是有了AI代理，我就不用担心它在想什么了。我想说什么就说什么。” 赵在科技公司字节跳动旗下的聊天机器人豆宝上创建了她的人工智能伴侣。上个月，字节跳动关闭了豆宝的配套功能。 这一事件在社交媒体上引发了愤怒，并凸显了中国人工智能的广泛使用与其潜在社会后果之间的紧张关系。 没有哪个国家像中国那样全面、热情地推出人工智能；该国的人口挑战迫使政府转向技术来解决未来的劳动力短缺问题。老年人使用聊天机器人来回答医疗问题，而幼儿则在学校接受人工智能教育。 但当局越来越担心人工智能可能会加剧现有的社会问题，包括孤独、失业以及（在北京看来）单身问题。 7 月 15 日推出的新规定禁止未成年人使用人工智能伴侣，并对向成年人销售的聊天机器人强制实施某些限制。包括豆宝在内的一些主要提供商完全删除了同伴功能以确保合规性。 政府表示担心聊天机器人会助长用户的“情感依赖或成瘾”。它警告公司不要提供“取代社交互动”的服务。 尽管许多国家都在努力解决如何限制人工智能聊天机器人的潜在危害，特别是对年轻人的潜在危害，但中国的规定是在全国范围内实施的最广泛的规定。 人们特别担心孤独危机，包括年轻人的孤独危机。中国高度数字化、以智能手机为基础的经济使得完全通过手持屏幕生活、工作和社交变得比以往任何时候都更加容易。 今年早些时候，一款应用程序以人们独自在家中死去为主题，名为“你死了吗？” – 短暂走红。中国约20%的家庭由独居者组成，预计到2030年这一比例将超过30%。 官方媒体三月份发布的一项调查发现，近一半的年轻人在感到孤独时会求助于虚拟伴侣。 香港城市大学副教授戴南希表示，政府担心的不仅仅是孤独感。 她说，随着出生率和结婚率的下降，...

reflection.en: The story of Zhao Wei and her AI companion, Wang Ye, touches on a deep human need for connection and understanding. As technology offers increasingly sophisticated ways to simulate companionship, we are reminded of the unique value of human relationships, created in the image of God. While AI can offer a listening ear, it cannot replicate the depth of...
reflection.zh: 赵薇和她的 AI 伴侣王野的故事触及了人类对连接和理解的深层需求。随着技术提供日益复杂的陪伴模拟方式，我们被提醒了造物主形象中人类关系的独特价值。虽然人工智能可以提供倾听，但它无法复制人类亲密关系中共享经验和相互成长的深度。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verse.textZh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。

title.en: Instagram CEO denies company hid low use of teen safety feature in Meta trial
title.zh: Instagram 首席执行官否认公司在 Meta 审判中隐瞒青少年安全功能使用率低的情况

summary.en: Instagram CEO Adam Mosseri testified in a trial brought by 29 US states, denying allegations that the company hid negative information from the public. He was questioned about not disclosing low user numbers for teen safety features, which he dismissed.
summary.zh: Instagram 首席执行官亚当·莫塞里（Adam Mosseri）在美国 29 个州提起的诉讼中作证，否认该公司向公众隐瞒负面信息的指控。他被问及未披露青少年安全功能使用率低的问题，但他对此不予理会。

body.en:
Instagram’s CEO disputed allegations by US prosecutors that his company hid negative information from the public while testifying during a blockbuster social media trial.

“I am not trying to encourage my team to hide anything,” the CEO, Adam Mosseri, told a California courtroom on Tuesday.

Mosseri is the first top executive from Meta , which owns both Instagram and Facebook, to testify in a historic lawsuit brought by 29 US states. His testimony began toward the end of the day on Tuesday and is slated to continue on Wednesday.

When the executive was posed with multiple questions about not disclosing low user numbers for Instagram’s features geared toward teen safety, he brushed them aside, saying: “We don’t publish every single stat.”

Jason Slothouber, a prosecutor for the state of Colorado, asked specifically about a tool called Take a Break, meant to encourage teens to close Instagram if they’d been scrolling for a while. Slothouber pointed out that just 1.8% of teens signed up for the feature, and that while Mosseri had touted the tool, he never publicly disclosed that number.

“I’ve definitely said publicly that the opt-in rates are low,” Mosseri responded. “I don’t know if I’ve said numbers.”

The jury trial, taking place in federal court in Oakland, California, began with opening statements last week. The lawsuit centers on the states’ allegations that Meta deliberately designed addictive products that hooked young people, leading to mental health issues, including anxiety, depression and suicide. The states additionally claim the social media company regularly collected data on children under the age of 13 without parental permission in violation of federal and state laws.

If found liable, Meta could be forced to pay damages as high as $200bn and change the design of its products to make them safer for kids. Legal experts say the outcome of this trial could fundamentally change the way social media apps function for young people.

Meta has denied all allegations, saying the states are chasing an “outlandish payout”. A spokesperson said Tuesday that Meta’s safety teams strive to be industry-leading and that Mosseri’s testimony showed the company does research to find ways to improve user experience.

Mosseri became the head of Instagram in 2018 and over the years has faced scrutiny about whether he may have dismissed internal warnings about the platform’s addictive design and negative effects on young people. He was called to testify before a Senate committee in December 2021 and as a witness in other trials about the alleged harm of social media to children.

On Tuesday, Slothouber asked Mosseri about a blog post he had published just one day before his Senate testimony. The post was titled “raising the standard for protecting teens and...
body.zh: Instagram 首席执行官对美国检察官的指控提出反驳，指控称其公司在一场轰动一时的社交媒体审判中作证时向公众隐瞒了负面信息。 “我并不是想鼓励我的团队隐瞒任何事情，”首席执行官亚当·莫塞里 (Adam Mosseri) 周二在加州法庭上表示。 Mosseri 是同时拥有 Instagram 和 Facebook 的 Meta 公司首位在美国 29 个州提起的历史性诉讼中作证的高管。他的证词于周二晚些时候开始，预计周三继续。 当这位高管被问到关于不披露 Instagram 面向青少年安全的功能的低用户数量的多个问题时，他置之不理，表示：“我们不会公布每一项统计数据。” 科罗拉多州检察官杰森·斯洛托伯 (Jason Slothouber) 特别询问了一款名为“休息一下”的工具，该工具旨在鼓励青少年在浏览 Instagram 一段时间后关闭 Instagram。斯洛托伯指出，只有 1.8% 的青少年注册了该功能，尽管莫塞里大力宣传该工具，但他从未公开透露过这个数字。 “我确实公开说过，选择加入率很低，”莫塞里回应道。 “我不知道我是否说了数字。” 陪审团审判在加利福尼亚州奥克兰联邦法院进行，上周以开庭陈词开始。该诉讼的核心是各州指控 Meta 故意设计成瘾产品来吸引年轻人，导致心理健康问题，包括焦虑、抑郁和自杀。各州还声称，这家社交媒体公司未经父母许可，经常收集 13 岁以下儿童的数据，违反了联邦和州法律。 如果被发现负有责任，Meta 可能会被迫支付高达 2000 亿美元的损失，并改变其产品的设计，使产品对儿童来说更安全。法律专家表示，这次审判的结果可能会从根本上改变社交媒体应用程序对年轻人的运作方式。 梅塔否认了所有指控，称各州正在追索“离奇的支出”。一位发言人周二表示，Meta 的安全团队力争成为行业领先，Mosseri 的证词表明该公司正在开展研究，寻找改善用户体验的方法。 Mosseri 于 2018 年成为 Instagram 的负责人，多年来一直面临着审查，质疑他是否可能忽视了有关该平台令人上瘾的设计和对年轻人产生负面影响的内部警告。 2021 年 12 月，他被传唤在参议院委员会作证，并作为证人参加了有关社交媒体对儿童涉嫌伤害的其他审判。 周二，斯洛托伯向莫塞里询问了他在参议院作证前一天发表的一篇博客文章的情况。这篇文章的标题是“提高保护青少年的标准……

reflection.en: In the midst of a high-profile trial, Instagram's CEO is defending the company against accusations of withholding information. This situation brings to light the tension between corporate interests and public accountability. Micah 6:8 reminds us that true leadership involves acting justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with God, principles that are...
reflection.zh: 在一场备受瞩目的审判中，Instagram 的首席执行官正在为公司辩护，以对抗被指控隐瞒信息的指控。这种情况凸显了公司利益与公众问责之间的紧张关系。弥迦书 6:8 提醒我们，真正的领导力在于秉公行义，喜爱怜悯，并谦卑地与神同行，这些原则在透明度和公众信任受到考验时尤为重要。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: AI gold rush draws crypto firms away from Bitcoin
title.zh: 人工智能淘金热吸引加密公司放弃比特币

summary.en: Companies that previously invested heavily in Bitcoin mining are now re-purposing their powerful computer infrastructure to support artificial intelligence development. This shift is occurring as Bitcoin's price has fallen significantly from its peak, while the AI sector is attracting billions in investment.
summary.zh: 曾大量投资比特币挖矿的公司，现在正将其强大的计算机基础设施重新用于支持人工智能开发。这一转变发生之际，比特币价格已从峰值大幅下跌，而人工智能领域正吸引着数十亿美元的投资。

body.en:
Companies that once filled warehouses with computers to earn Bitcoin - a process known as mining - are now using that computing power for AI.

Bitcoin mining companies invested large sums on giant banks of powerful computers as the price of Bitcoin rocketed in recent years .

But those mining companies have faced falling rewards since the value of the cryptocurrency has slumped from its peak in October 2025.

Now many are pivoting to AI and signing deals with companies such as Anthropic - who are spending billions of dollars on the infrastructure needed to keep up in the AI race.

Like AI systems, Bitcoin relies on vast networks of powerful computers housed in data centres.

Because Bitcoin operates without a central authority, these computers verify transactions and are rewarded with newly-created digital coins.

But the rewards have reduced and the value of coins has dropped since last year.

One bitcoin was worth about $124,000 (£91,000) at its peak in October 2025, but has since fallen sharply.

More recently, it has rallied to around $80,000 - meaning it is up almost 30% so far in August.

But, for companies that have already made the change, even that may not be enough to get them to return to the crypto industry, because the switch of use - once made - is expensive to undo.

Industry analysts say Bitcoin mining companies have been pivoting to AI because they have years of experience in finding cheap electricity and efficiently running large data centres.

TerraWulf, Ionic Digital, Core Scientific, Iris Energy, Bitdeer, Riot Platforms and Hut 8 are just some of the companies increasingly diverting investment and infrastructure from bitcoin mining towards AI.

Riot Platforms signed a $9bn, 20-year compute deal with Anthropic earlier this month.

TerraWulf's website once described the firm as an "infrastructure-focused bitcoin mining company".

Enegix, which opened a huge Bitcoin mining site in Kazakhstan to great fanfare in 2020, is now pivoting too.

"Today, we are moving confidently towards artificial intelligence and planning the gradual alignment of our energy and infrastructure capabilities, both in Kazakhstan and elsewhere, towards the development of AI infrastructure," said the company's chief executive Yerbolsyn Sarsenov.

Enegix says it is in active discussions with AI and HPC (high-performance computing) companies and planning to transform a "significant" portion of the business to AI.

But refitting crypto mines for AI is expensive and in some cases the companies have had to sell some of their Bitcoin holdings to fund the switch.

Wolfie Zhao from The Energy Mag - a publication that rebranded from The Miner Mag to reflect the trend - predicts the industry pivot will continue even as the price of Bitcoin has risen in recent days.

"We...
body.zh: 曾经在仓库里装满计算机来赚取比特币的公司（这一过程称为挖矿）现在正在将这种计算能力用于人工智能。 近年来，随着比特币价格的飙升，比特币挖矿公司向拥有强大计算机的巨型银行投入了大量资金。 但自从加密货币的价值从 2025 年 10 月的峰值下跌以来，这些矿业公司面临着回报下降的局面。 现在，许多人正在转向人工智能，并与 Anthropic 等公司签署协议——这些公司正花费数十亿美元购买人工智能竞赛所需的基础设施。 与人工智能系统一样，比特币依赖于数据中心内强大计算机组成的庞大网络。 由于比特币的运行没有中央权威，这些计算机会验证交易并获得新创建的数字硬币的奖励。 但从去年开始，奖励减少了，硬币的价值也下降了。 一枚比特币在 2025 年 10 月达到峰值时价值约 124,000 美元（91,000 英镑），但此后急剧下跌。 最近，它已反弹至 80,000 美元左右，这意味着 8 月份迄今已上涨近 30%。 但是，对于已经做出改变的公司来说，即使这样也可能不足以让他们重返加密货币行业，因为一旦改变用途，撤销的成本就很高。 行业分析师表示，比特币挖矿公司一直在转向人工智能，因为他们在寻找廉价电力和高效运行大型数据中心方面拥有多年的经验。 TerraWulf、Ionic Digital、Core Scientific、Iris Energy、Bitdeer、Riot Platforms 和 Hut 8 只是越来越多地将投资和基础设施从比特币挖矿转向人工智能的公司中的一部分。 Riot Platforms 本月早些时候与 Anthropic 签署了一项价值 90 亿美元、为期 20 年的计算协议。 TerraWulf 的网站曾将该公司描述为“一家专注于基础设施的比特币挖矿公司”。 Enegix 于 2020 年在哈萨克斯坦大张旗鼓地开设了一个大型比特币矿场，现在也正在转型。 该公司首席执行官 Yerbolsyn Sarsenov 表示：“今天，我们充满信心地迈向人工智能，并计划逐步调整我们在哈萨克斯坦和其他地方的能源和基础设施能力，以发展人工智能基础设施。” Enegix 表示，它正在与人工智能和 HPC（高性能计算）公司进行积极讨论，并计划将业务的“重要”部分转变为人工智能。 但为人工智能改造加密货币矿场成本高昂，在某些情况下，这些公司不得不出售部分比特币资产来为这一转变提供资金。 《能源杂志》（为反映这一趋势而从《矿工杂志》更名为《能源杂志》）的 Wolfie Zhu 预测，尽管比特币价格最近几天有所上涨，但行业的重心仍将持续。 “我们...

reflection.en: The rapid pivot of crypto firms from Bitcoin mining to AI, driven by market shifts and the promise of new billions, highlights the transient nature of earthly pursuits. Just as Bitcoin's value slumped from its peak, so too can any treasure we store up on earth prove fleeting. This story invites us to consider where our true and lasting investments lie.
reflection.zh: 加密货币公司因市场变化和数十亿美元的新机遇，迅速从比特币挖矿转向人工智能，这突显了世俗追求的短暂性。正如比特币的价值从高峰跌落一样，我们积攒在地上的一切财宝也可能转瞬即逝。这个故事邀请我们思考，我们真正持久的投资在哪里。

verse.textEn: Do not store up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moths and vermin destroy.
verse.textZh: 不要为自己积攒财宝在地上；地上有虫子咬，能锈坏。

title.en: The world's busiest spaceport is about to get a lot quieter, at least for now
title.zh: 全球最繁忙航天港即将迎来一段沉寂期

summary.en: SpaceX is significantly reducing its launch frequency from Florida's Space Coast as it shifts focus toward the future Starship program. While the Falcon 9 has been a prolific workhorse with over 160 launches last year, the region will see a temporary lull until Starship operations are ready, likely around 2027.
summary.zh: SpaceX 正在大幅减少佛罗里达州太空海岸的发射频率，将其重点转向未来的星舰计划。尽管猎鹰 9 号去年完成了超过 160 次发射，是名副其实的“劳模”，但在星舰准备就绪之前（预计在 2027 年左右），该地区将进入一段暂时的沉寂期。

body.en: SpaceX made Florida's Space Coast home to the world's busiest spaceport for a decade, but that will change this year. The company is significantly cutting the number of launches from Florida until Starship arrives, a senior SpaceX official confirmed Tuesday. The Falcon 9 rocket has been SpaceX's workhorse, routinely launching batches of satellites for the company's Starlink network, primarily from launch pads at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station and NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida. There were 165 Falcon 9 launches last year—about three flights per week—and about 75 percent of them carried Starlink satellites. This year is different. SpaceX has launched more missions from its West Coast launch pad at Vandenberg Space Force Base in California since January, and this trend will amplify for the rest of the year. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 十年来，SpaceX 使佛罗里达州太空海岸成为世界上最繁忙的太空港，但今年情况将发生改变。 SpaceX 的一位高级官员周二证实，该公司将大幅削减在 Starship 抵达之前从佛罗里达州出发的发射次数。猎鹰 9 号火箭一直是 SpaceX 的主力，定期为该公司的星链网络发射批量卫星，主要是从卡纳维拉尔角太空部队站和美国宇航局佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心的发射台发射。去年猎鹰 9 号发射了 165 次——大约每周 3 次——其中约 75% 携带星链卫星。今年有所不同。自 1 月份以来，SpaceX 从位于加利福尼亚州范登堡太空部队基地的西海岸发射台发射了更多任务，这一趋势将在今年剩余时间内加剧。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The transition at Cape Canaveral reminds us that even the most relentless progress requires seasons of recalibration. As the Falcon 9 yields the stage to the next generation of Starship, we see that every great human endeavor has its rhythm of activity and waiting. In our own lives, we can trust Yahweh during the quiet seasons, knowing they are often the...
reflection.zh: 卡纳维拉尔角的这一转型提醒我们，即使是最不懈的进步也需要重新调整的季节。当猎鹰 9 号为下一代星舰让出舞台时，我们看到人类的每一项伟大事业都有其活跃与等待的节奏。在我们的生活中，我们可以在安静的季节里信靠雅伟，因为这些时期往往是通往新高度的必要序曲。

verse.textEn: There is a time for everything, and a season for every activity under the heavens.
verse.textZh: 凡事都有定期，天下万务都有定时。

title.en: World humanoid robot games show runners breaking records, bursting into flames
title.zh: 世界人形机器人运动会：跑者打破纪录，却也起火燃烧

summary.en: The World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing showcased robots sprinting faster than human records, but many struggled with basic stability, crashing into barriers or catching fire. While the speed is impressive, the event highlighted that these machines still lack the nuanced control required for practical tasks or even...
summary.zh: 在北京举行的世界人形机器人运动会上，机器人展示了超越人类纪录的冲刺速度，但许多机器人难以保持基本稳定性，撞上障碍物甚至起火。虽然速度令人印象深刻，但此次活动凸显了这些机器在执行实际任务或安全停止方面仍缺乏细微的控制能力。

body.en: Viral videos of the World Humanoid Robot Games show sprinting robots beating the human 100-meter record held by Usain Bolt—but also feature running robots crashing into barriers and falling down because they cannot readily stop running. A few fallen robots even break at the waist in a shower of sparks or catch on fire. That demonstration of both robotic prowess and limitations came from the second edition of the World Humanoid Robot Games hosted in Beijing from August 22–26. Like the inaugural event held in 2025, this year’s event challenged humanoid robots to run fast, perform kung fu or dance moves, fight one another in kickboxing, and play soccer or table tennis. This year’s games also tested robots in more humdrum practical scenarios like washing and hanging laundry, where they appeared to lag behind typical human working speeds. That suggests the event organizers, including Chinese state media and the Beijing city government, are keen to showcase the commercial potential of humanoid robots at a time when China’s robotics industry is rapidly developing and testing such robots. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 世界人形机器人运动会的病毒视频显示，短跑机器人打破了尤塞恩·博尔特 (Usain Bolt) 保持的人类 100 米纪录，但也有跑步机器人因无法轻易停止奔跑而撞上障碍物并摔倒的情况。一些坠落的机器人甚至在一阵火花中腰部折断或着火。 8 月 22 日至 26 日在北京举办的第二届世界人形机器人运动会展示了机器人的实力和局限性。与 2025 年举办的首届赛事一样，今年的赛事挑战人形机器人快速奔跑、表演功夫或舞蹈动作、踢拳击、踢足球或乒乓球。今年的比赛还在更单调的实际场景中测试了机器人，例如洗衣和晾衣服，它们似乎落后于人类的典型工作速度。这表明，在中国机器人行业正在快速开发和测试此类机器人之际，包括中国官方媒体和北京市政府在内的活动组织者热衷于展示人形机器人的商业潜力。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The spectacle of robots outrunning Olympic legends only to crash into barriers reminds us that speed is not the same as mastery. In our rush to push the boundaries of what is possible, we often neglect the stability and control necessary for true utility. Yahweh invites us to seek a wisdom that values the 'beneficial' over the merely 'possible,' ensuring...
reflection.zh: 机器人跑赢了奥运传奇却撞上障碍物，这一奇观提醒我们，速度并不等同于掌控。在我们急于突破可能性的界限时，往往忽略了真正实用所需的稳定性和控制力。雅伟邀请我们寻求一种智慧，看重“有益”过于仅仅是“可能”，确保我们的工具既卓越又可靠。

verse.textEn: "I have the right to do anything," you say — but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything" — but not everything is constructive.
verse.textZh: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处；凡事都可行，但不都造就人。

title.en: Tech Life
title.zh: 科技生活：英国高级研究与发明局（ARIA）及其高风险研究

summary.en: ARIA is the UK's new research and development funding agency designed to unlock high-risk, high-reward scientific breakthroughs. The report also highlights technology empowering disabled racing drivers to compete and the emerging use of AI-generated consumer complaints.
summary.zh: 英国高级研究与发明局（ARIA）是英国新成立的研发资助机构，旨在开启高风险、高回报的科学突破。该报道还重点介绍了助力残障赛车手参加比赛的技术，以及新兴的人工智能生成消费者投诉的应用。

body.en: ARIA is the UK's research and development funding agency that's built to unlock new scientific and technological developments. We speak to ARIA's new boss about their work. Also this week: the tech that's helping disabled racing drivers to achieve their dreams. And the pros and cons of making AI-generated complaints. Presenter: Chris Vallance Producer: Tom Quinn (Image: An illustration of a light bulb, representing creative thoughts and ideas. Two human hands attempt to grasp the image. Credit: Getty Images)
body.zh: ARIA 是英国的研发资助机构，旨在推动新的科学技术发展。我们与 ARIA 的新老板谈论了他们的工作。同样在本周：帮助残疾赛车手实现梦想的技术。以及人工智能生成投诉的利弊。演示者：Chris Vallance 制片人：Tom Quinn（图片：灯泡插图，代表创意思想和想法。两只人手试图抓住图像。图片来源：Getty Images）

reflection.en: The mission of ARIA to fund high-risk research reminds us that the universe contains deep mysteries designed for us to uncover. From scientific breakthroughs to the specialized tech helping disabled racing drivers, our pursuit of knowledge honors the complexity of the world Yahweh has made. Searching out these hidden possibilities is a noble calling that...
reflection.zh: 英国高级研究与发明局（ARIA）资助高风险研究的使命提醒我们，宇宙中蕴含着深奥的奥秘，等待着我们去揭开。从科学突破到助力残障赛车手的专门技术，我们对知识的追求体现了对雅伟所造世界的敬畏。去察清这些隐藏的可能性是一项崇高的呼召，反映了我们作为受造界潜能管家的角色。

verse.textEn: It is the glory of God to conceal a matter; to search out a matter is the glory of kings.
verse.textZh: 将事隐秘乃神的荣耀；将事察清乃君王的荣耀。

title.en: Taiwan charges nine people for smuggling ‘high-end’ AI servers to China
title.zh: 台湾指控九人向中国走私“高端”人工智能服务器

summary.en: Taiwanese prosecutors have charged nine individuals, including employees from Nvidia and Super Micro, with illegally exporting high-end AI servers to mainland China. This action marks another development in the ongoing technology rivalry between the United States and China, specifically concerning advanced artificial...
summary.zh: 台湾检察官已起诉九人，其中包括英伟达和美超微的员工，指控他们非法向中国大陆出口高端人工智能服务器。此举标志着中美之间在先进人工智能硬件方面的技术竞争又一进展。

body.en: Among those charged are two Super Micro employees and one from Nvidia, marking another flashpoint in US-China AI rivalry Taiwanese prosecutors charged nine people Monday, including one from Nvidia and two from Super Micro, for illegally exporting “high-end AI servers” to mainland China, adding another wave of turbulence in the AI ​​rivalry between China and the United States. Prosecutors said the servers involved were graphics processing units known as “B300,” which have been banned from sale to China. Continue reading...
body.zh: 被指控的人中包括两名超微员工和一名来自英伟达的员工，这标志着中美人工智能竞争的又一个爆发点。台湾检方周一对九人提出指控，其中包括一名英伟达员工和两名超微员工，罪名是非法向中国大陆出口“高端人工智能服务器”，为中美之间的人工智能竞争再添一波动荡。检察官称，涉案服务器是名为“B300”的图形处理单元，已被禁止向中国销售。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The charges against nine individuals for illegally exporting high-end AI servers highlight the complex ethical landscape of advanced technology. While innovation brings powerful tools, the 'US-China AI rivalry' reminds us that not all capabilities are beneficial when used in contexts of strategic competition. This situation prompts reflection on how we...
reflection.zh: 对九名非法出口高端人工智能服务器的个人提出的指控，凸显了先进技术复杂的伦理格局。虽然创新带来了强大的工具，但“中美人工智能竞争”提醒我们，并非所有能力在战略竞争背景下都是有益的。这种情况促使我们反思如何管理强大的技术，确保其开发和分发真正地造就人，而不是制造进一步的紧张。

verse.textEn: "I have the right to do anything," you say — but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything" — but not everything is constructive.
verse.textZh: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处；凡事都可行，但不都造就人。

title.en: Preserving glow-in-the-dark art and fashion for future generations
title.zh: 为子孙后代保存夜光艺术与时尚

summary.en: Understanding unique photochemistry of such materials will help in conservation, storage, and exhibition.
summary.zh: 了解这些材料独特的物理化学特性将有助于其保存、储存和展览。

body.en: Fashionistas of a certain age no doubt remember the late designer Stephen Sprouse , who gave Blondie's Debbie Harry her distinctive Bowery punk style. Sprouse's first collections in the mid-1980s made a major splash, melding graffiti prints, a playful '60s aesthetic, and bright Day-Glo colors that won admirers such as Andy Warhol. Several examples of Sprouse's work are preserved in the textiles collection of the Indianapolis Museum of Art at Newfields, where conservationists are trying to learn more about the phosphorescent and fluorescent pigments the designer used in his creations in order to keep the colors from dulling over time. They described recent advances in that research at a meeting of the American Chemical Society (ACS) held this week in Chicago. Scientists began describing minerals that glowed in the dark as phosphors in the Middle Ages. Typically, such materials take on a charge when exposed to light, storing the absorbed energy and releasing it gradually as re-emitted light. Henri Becquerel discovered radioactive decay in 1896 because of his work with phosphorescent uranium salts: He left the salts in a closed drawer with photographic plates, which fogged up even without a light source. DayGlo paints and similar materials exploit the related phenomenon of fluorescence. DayGlo pigments fluoresce in daylight by essentially converting UV light into visible light to produce brighter, more vibrant colors. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 某个年龄段的时尚达人无疑还记得已故设计师 Stephen Sprouse，他为 Blondie 的 Debbie Harry 赋予了独特的 Bowery 朋克风格。 Sprouse 在 20 世纪 80 年代中期推出的首个系列引起了巨大轰动，融合了涂鸦印花、俏皮的 60 年代美学以及明亮的 Day-Glo 色彩，赢得了安迪·沃霍尔 (Andy Warhol) 等崇拜者的青睐。纽菲尔德印第安纳波利斯艺术博物馆的纺织品收藏中保存了斯普罗斯作品的几个例子，那里的自然资源保护主义者正在尝试更多地了解设计师在他的创作中使用的磷光和荧光颜料，以防止颜色随着时间的推移而变暗。他们在本周于芝加哥举行的美国化学会 (ACS) 会议上描述了该研究的最新进展。中世纪时，科学家们开始将在黑暗中发光的矿物质描述为磷光体。通常，此类材料在暴露于光时会带电，存储吸收的能量并以重新发射的光的形式逐渐释放能量。 1896 年，亨利·贝克勒尔 (Henri Becquerel) 在研究磷光铀盐时发现了放射性衰变：他将盐放在一个装有照相底片的封闭抽屉中，即使没有光源，底片也会起雾。 DayGlo 涂料和类似材料利用了相关的荧光现象。 DayGlo 颜料在日光下发出荧光，本质上是将紫外线转化为可见光，从而产生更明亮、更鲜艳的颜色。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The dedicated work of conservationists at the Indianapolis Museum of Art, researching the unique photochemistry of Stephen Sprouse's glow-in-the-dark creations, reflects a profound commitment to preserving human ingenuity and beauty. Their efforts to understand these hidden properties for future generations echo the wisdom that finds glory in diligently...
reflection.zh: 印第安纳波利斯艺术博物馆的文物保护专家们，致力于研究设计师斯蒂芬·斯普劳斯夜光作品独特的物理化学特性，这体现了他们对保存人类创造力和美的深切承诺。他们为子孙后代理解这些隐藏特性的努力，呼应了在勤奋探寻隐秘事物中发现荣耀的智慧。这种耐心的求知精神确保了艺术和时尚的鲜活遗产能够继续启发后人。

verse.textEn: It is the glory of God to conceal a matter; to search out a matter is the glory of kings.
verse.textZh: 将事隐秘乃神的荣耀；将事察清乃君王的荣耀。

title.en: Google's anti-nausea Motion Assist dots finally rolling out on Android
title.zh: 谷歌的防晕动辅助点功能终于在安卓系统上推出

summary.en: Google's Motion Assist dots, designed to alleviate motion sickness by addressing the sensory mismatch between the inner ear and eyes, are now slowly rolling out on Android, currently appearing only on Pixels running Android 17.
summary.zh: 谷歌的防晕动辅助点功能旨在通过解决内耳和眼睛之间的感官不匹配来缓解晕动症，目前正在安卓系统上缓慢推出，仅在运行安卓17的Pixel手机上可见。

body.en: Some people are cursed with motion sickness, which can make it impossible to read or use a phone in a moving vehicle without suffering waves of nausea. There's a surprisingly simple trick that can make smartphones usable in such situations. Apple deployed it on the iPhone a couple of years ago, and now Google's own version is finally coming (slowly) to Android. Motion sickness is caused by a disagreement between what your inner ear senses and what your eyes see. If you're looking at a book or a screen while in a car, the sensory mismatch can lead to a pretty unpleasant time. As part of iOS 18 in 2024, Apple released a feature called Motion Cues that places a network of moving dots on the screen to alleviate motion sickness, and it seems to work surprisingly well. Google's version is similar, but it's called Motion Assist. Google began testing Motion Assist back in 2024, but it never expanded beyond an internal test until now. Android Authority reports Motion Assist is appearing on Pixel phones running Android 17, but there's no app or update you can install to get the feature—it's being delivered by Play Services as part of a staged rollout. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 有些人患有晕车症，在行驶的车辆中阅读或使用手机时会感到一阵阵恶心。有一个令人惊讶的简单技巧可以使智能手机在这种情况下可用。几年前，苹果公司在 iPhone 上部署了它，现在谷歌自己的版本终于（缓慢地）登陆 Android 了。晕动病是由于内耳感觉与眼睛看到的不一致引起的。如果你在车里看书或看屏幕，感官上的不匹配可能会导致一段非常不愉快的时光。作为 2024 年 iOS 18 的一部分，苹果发布了一项名为 Motion Cues 的功能，该功能在屏幕上放置移动点网络来缓解晕动病，而且效果似乎出奇的好。谷歌的版本类似，但它被称为Motion Assist。谷歌早在 2024 年就开始测试 Motion Assist，但直到现在才扩展到内部测试之外。 Android Authority 报告称，Motion Assist 出现在运行 Android 17 的 Pixel 手机上，但您无法安装任何应用程序或更新来获取该功能，该功能由 Play Services 作为分阶段推出的一部分提供。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The development of Google's Motion Assist dots, which address the sensory mismatch causing motion sickness, highlights humanity's persistent drive to understand and alleviate physical discomforts. This technological solution, now rolling out on Android, reflects the "glory of kings" in searching out matters, applying knowledge to improve daily life. It...
reflection.zh: 谷歌防晕动辅助点功能的开发，旨在解决导致晕动症的感官不匹配问题，这突显了人类不断探索和减轻身体不适的动力。这项正在安卓系统上推出的技术解决方案，体现了“君王的荣耀”在于查明事物，运用知识改善日常生活。它提醒我们，即使是看似微小的创新也能带来缓解，并展现了雅伟赋予我们的智慧。

verse.textEn: It is the glory of God to conceal a matter; to search out a matter is the glory of kings.
verse.textZh: 将事隐秘乃神的荣耀；将事察清乃君王的荣耀。

title.en: Trump-backed Ken Paxton unveils ‘Texas first’ datacenter plan aimed at ‘negative impact’
title.zh: 特朗普支持的肯·帕克斯顿公布“德州优先”数据中心计划，旨在应对“负面影响”

summary.en: Republican Senate candidate Ken Paxton unveiled a "Texas first" datacenter plan to address perceived "negative impacts," but the accompanying graphic on X was flagged as "Made with AI." Paxton, endorsed by Donald Trump, is in a tight race for the US Senate in Texas.
summary.zh: 共和党参议员候选人肯·帕克斯顿公布了一项“德州优先”的数据中心计划，旨在应对其“负面影响”，但他在社交媒体平台X上发布的配图被标记为“由AI生成”。帕克斯顿获得了唐纳德·特朗普的支持，目前在德克萨斯州的参议员竞选中面临激烈竞争。

body.en: The Republican Senate candidate announced the plan with a graphic flagged as ‘Made with AI’ US politics live – latest updates Ken Paxton , a Republican candidate for the US Senate in Texas, has unveiled plans to tackle the “negative impact” of datacenters amid a growing backlash across the political spectrum. Paxton, endorsed by Donald Trump but facing a close contest against Democrat James Talarico, posted a “Texas first” datacenter plan on X with a graphic that the social media network flagged as “Made with AI”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 共和党参议院候选人宣布了该计划，并用一张标记为“人工智能制造”的图形来宣布美国政治直播——最新动态德克萨斯州美国参议院共和党候选人肯·帕克斯顿(Ken Paxton)公布了解决数据中心“负面影响”的计划，以应对各政治派别日益强烈的反对声音。帕克斯顿得到了唐纳德·特朗普的支持，但面临着与民主党人詹姆斯·塔拉里科的激烈竞争，他在 X 上发布了“德克萨斯州首个”数据中心计划，并在社交媒体网络上标记为“人工智能制造”的图形。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In an age where artificial intelligence can create convincing images, the flagging of Ken Paxton's campaign graphic as "Made with AI" highlights the growing need for transparency in public discourse. Yahweh's call to "speak the truth with his neighbor" reminds us that clear, honest communication builds trust, especially from those seeking to lead. As...
reflection.zh: 在人工智能可以生成逼真图像的时代，肯·帕克斯顿竞选海报被标记为“由AI生成”，凸显了公共话语中日益增长的透明度需求。雅伟呼吁我们“与邻舍说实话”，提醒我们清晰、诚实的沟通能建立信任，特别是对于那些寻求领导的人。随着技术模糊了现实与模拟的界限，对真理的承诺仍然是健康社区和治理的基石。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.en: Two unvaccinated people die from measles in Pennsylvania, officials confirm
title.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州确认两名未接种疫苗者死于麻疹

summary.en: Health officials in Pennsylvania confirmed the deaths of two unvaccinated residents from Lancaster County due to measles, marking the state's first such deaths in 35 years. The report highlights a growing concern that many people no longer recognize the potential severity of the disease, which had seen no US deaths...
summary.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州卫生官员确认，兰开斯特县两名未接种疫苗的居民因患麻疹去世，这是该州35年来首次报告麻疹死亡病例。报告强调了一个日益令人担忧的问题，即许多人不再认识到这种疾病的潜在严重性；在最近之前，美国已有近十年没有出现过麻疹死亡病例。

body.en: Two unvaccinated people have died from measles in Pennsylvania, state health officials confirmed Tuesday . They are the first measles deaths reported in Pennsylvania in 35 years and the first deaths reported in the US in 2026. Last year, the US saw three measles deaths : two in otherwise-healthy but unvaccinated school-age children in Texas and one in an unvaccinated adult in New Mexico. Prior to those deaths, the US had not seen a measles death since 2015 , when a woman with underlying conditions became severely ill. Citing privacy, health officials in Pennsylvania are not providing information on the people who died beyond that they were unvaccinated and were residents of Lancaster County. Officials noted that the deaths are among 393 confirmed cases reported this year across 28 counties in the state. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州卫生官员周二证实，宾夕法尼亚州有两名未接种疫苗的人死于麻疹。这是宾夕法尼亚州 35 年来首次报告的麻疹死亡病例，也是美国 2026 年报告的第一例麻疹死亡病例。去年，美国发生了 3 例麻疹死亡事件：德克萨斯州有 2 例健康但未接种疫苗的学龄儿童，新墨西哥州有 1 例未接种疫苗的成年人。在此之前，美国自 2015 年一名患有基础疾病的女性病情严重以来，就没有出现过麻疹死亡事件。宾夕法尼亚州卫生官员以隐私为由，没有提供有关死者的信息，除了未接种疫苗且是兰开斯特县居民的信息。官员们指出，今年该州 28 个县报告了 393 例确诊病例，其中包括这些死亡病例。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The loss of two lives in Lancaster County reminds us that physical health often depends on the quiet wisdom of precaution. While we often take for granted the safety provided by past medical breakthroughs, neglecting these protections can lead to tragic and preventable outcomes. We are called to value the gift of life by acting with foresight and care for...
reflection.zh: 兰开斯特县两名生命的逝去提醒我们，身体健康往往取决于未雨绸缪的静谧智慧。虽然我们常常理所当然地享受着过去医学突破所带来的安全感，但忽视这些保护措施可能会导致悲剧性且本可避免的后果。我们受召要以远见卓识来珍视生命的恩赐，并为自己和邻舍的福祉尽到关怀之责。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: SpaceX intends to invest up to $100 billion in massive Louisiana spaceport
title.zh: SpaceX计划在路易斯安那州大型太空港投资高达1000亿美元

summary.en: Louisiana Governor Jeff Landry announced that SpaceX plans to invest up to $100 billion in the state's coastal areas to develop Starship factories and launch pads. This new "Starbase Louisiana" facility aims to replicate and expand upon the company's existing Starbase in southern Texas, becoming a self-sustaining...
summary.zh: 路易斯安那州州长杰夫·兰德里宣布，SpaceX计划在该州沿海地区投资高达1000亿美元，用于开发星舰工厂和发射台。这个新的“路易斯安那星舰基地”旨在复制并扩大该公司在德克萨斯州南部现有的星舰基地，成为一个可自给自足的太空港，并可获取甲烷推进剂。

body.en: Louisiana Gov. Jeff Landry said Tuesday that SpaceX will commit $100 billion to develop Starship factories and launch pads in the state's coastal areas. In doing so, the company seeks to replicate the Starbase facility it has built over the last decade in southern Texas on a larger scale. The announcement capped months of speculation about SpaceX's interest in a sprawling parcel of land along the Gulf coast of Louisiana, which offers room to build multiple launch towers and offers access to the methane propellant that fuels the Starship rocket. Gwynne Shotwell, the president and chief operating officer of SpaceX, said the "Starbase Louisiana" facility would become a self-sustaining spaceport with propellant production, power generation, deep-water shipping capabilities, vehicle processing facilities, and an airport on site. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 路易斯安那州州长杰夫·兰德里周二表示，SpaceX 将投入 1000 亿美元在该州沿海地区开发 Starship 工厂和发射台。在此过程中，该公司寻求更大规模地复制过去十年在德克萨斯州南部建造的 Starbase 设施。这一声明结束了数月来有关 SpaceX 对路易斯安那州墨西哥湾沿岸一大片土地感兴趣的猜测，该土地提供了建造多个发射塔的空间，并提供了为星舰火箭提供燃料的甲烷推进剂。 SpaceX 总裁兼首席运营官格温·肖特韦尔 (Gwynne Shotwell) 表示，“路易斯安那州星际基地”设施将成为一个自我维持的太空港，拥有推进剂生产、发电、深水运输能力、车辆处理设施和机场。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The announcement of SpaceX's $100 billion investment in a Louisiana spaceport highlights the immense scale of human ambition and planning. As this "project like no other" takes shape, it reminds us of the wisdom in Proverbs 16:3, which encourages us to commit our plans to Yahweh. Such a massive undertaking, aiming to build Starship factories and launch...
reflection.zh: SpaceX宣布将在路易斯安那州投资1000亿美元建设一座大型太空港，这彰显了人类宏大的抱负和规划能力。当这个“前所未有的项目”逐步成形时，它提醒我们箴言16:3的智慧，鼓励我们将自己的工作交托给雅伟。这项旨在建造星舰工厂和发射台的巨大工程，反映了人类探索和建设未来的深切动力。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Songs created by AI banned from Australia's music charts
title.zh: 澳大利亚音乐排行榜禁止人工智能创作的歌曲

summary.en: Australia's music charts have banned songs largely or wholly created by AI, a move that follows a controversy where an AI-remixed Madonna song topped the dance charts and was widely streamed.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚音乐排行榜已禁止主要或完全由人工智能创作的歌曲，此前一首由人工智能混音的麦当娜歌曲曾登上舞曲榜榜首并被广泛播放，引发了争议。

body.en:
Songs that are largely or wholly created by AI have been banned from Australia's music charts.

The Australian Recording Industry Association (ARIA) said the new code would help "promote the human nature of artistry".

It follows a controversy around a cover of Madonna's Like A Prayer by Australian DJ Josh Fawaz which recently topped the ARIA dance singles chart and peaked at number 2 on the country's overall chart.

The song has become a staple of commercial radio station playlists and been streamed more than 48 million times on Spotify alone.

ARIA said that Australian artists were competing for attention "in the most crowded market in history" and that it was "not interested in promoting or celebrating the success of AI-generated music that does not contain human artistry".

Under the new rules, AI assistance can still be used, but humans must have written the song, and have performed the lead vocal and primary instruments.

AI can also still be used for mastering songs and, for example, using drum machines and auto tune.

Earlier this year a song was banned from Sweden's music charts because it was created by AI.

And in July, the International Federation of the Phonographic Industry (IFPI) said AI guidelines would be rolled out in Latin America, the Middle East, Africa and Southeast Asia for use in their official charts.

The updated code, based on the IFPI directive, also excludes music that raises "stream or chart manipulation concerns".

ARIA chief executive Annabelle Herd said: "These changes reflect our intent to remain dynamic and promote the human nature of artistry in what is, to say the least, a rapidly developing space."

"Artists already use AI tools in their work, the charts can and should evolve to keep room for that, but music generated wholesale by services built on artists' recordings is a different matter."

She added: "A chart that rewards unlicensed AI output would undercut the very basis of the recorded music we exist to represent."

Artists will be required to declare AI use when they submit a song for chart consideration.

ARIA said that if it later emerged music was largely AI-generated it could retrospectively adjust chart positions, and if the piece topped the charts, it may request that awards given for reaching Number One were returned.

Last month, they shared an AI-assisted version of their 2014 hit High on Instagram, captioned: "When you re-record your own song with AI so Australian radio will play it."

Band member Adam Hyde told Channel Nine's Today show that AI-generated music was "removing the human experience from life".

In July this year, Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese promised "the strongest possible protection" from AI for Australian creatives.

Albanese pledged that writers and musicians would...
body.zh: 大部分或完全由人工智能创作的歌曲已被禁止出现在澳大利亚音乐排行榜上。 澳大利亚唱片工业协会（ARIA）表示，新准则将有助于“促进艺术的人性化”。 此前，澳大利亚 DJ Josh Fawaz 翻唱了麦当娜的《Like A Prayer》引发争议，该歌曲最近登上了 ARIA 舞曲单曲榜榜首，并在该国总体排行榜上排名第二。 这首歌已成为商业广播电台播放列表的主要内容，仅在 Spotify 上的播放量就超过 4800 万次。 ARIA 表示，澳大利亚艺术家正在“在历史上最拥挤的市场”中争夺注意力，并且“对推广或庆祝不包含人类艺术性的人工智能生成音乐的成功不感兴趣”。 根据新规则，仍然可以使用人工智能辅助，但歌曲必须由人类创作，并演奏主唱和主要乐器。 人工智能仍然可以用于掌握歌曲，例如使用鼓机和自动调音。 今年早些时候，瑞典音乐排行榜禁止一首歌曲，因为它是由人工智能创作的。 7 月，国际唱片业联合会 (IFPI) 表示，人工智能指南将在拉丁美洲、中东、非洲和东南亚推出，用于其官方排行榜。 更新后的代码基于 IFPI 指令，还排除了引发“流媒体或图表操纵问题”的音乐。 ARIA 首席执行官安娜贝尔·赫德 (Annabelle Herd) 表示：“这些变化反映了我们在这个快速发展的领域保持活力并提升艺术人性的意图。” “艺术家已经在他们的工作中使用人工智能工具，图表可以而且应该不断发展以为此留出空间，但通过基于艺术家录音的服务批量生成的音乐是另一回事。” 她补充道：“奖励未经许可的人工智能输出的图表将削弱我们所代表的录制音乐的基础。” 艺术家在提交歌曲供排行榜考虑时将被要求声明人工智能的使用。 ARIA 表示，如果后来发现音乐主要是由人工智能生成的，它可以回顾性地调整排行榜位置，如果这首作品名列榜首，它可能会要求退回为达到第一名而颁发的奖项。 上个月，他们在 Instagram 上分享了 2014 年热门歌曲《High》的人工智能辅助版本，标题是：“当你用人工智能重新录制自己的歌曲时，澳大利亚电台就会播放它。” 乐队成员亚当·海德 (Adam Hyde) 在第九频道的《今日》节目中表示，人工智能生成的音乐正在“消除人类的生活体验”。 今年 7 月，澳大利亚总理 Anthony Albanese 承诺为澳大利亚创意人员提供“尽可能最强的保护”，使其免受人工智能的侵害。 阿尔巴尼斯承诺作家和音乐家将...

reflection.en: The Australian Recording Industry Association's decision to ban AI-generated songs from its charts underscores a deep human intuition: there is something uniquely valuable about art born from human experience and creativity. While AI can mimic and generate, the biblical truth of humanity being created in Yahweh's image (Genesis 1:27) suggests a distinct...
reflection.zh: 澳大利亚唱片业协会禁止人工智能创作的歌曲登上排行榜的决定，突显了人类内心深处的一种直觉：源于人类经验和创造力的艺术具有独特的价值。尽管人工智能可以模仿和生成，但圣经中关于人类是按照雅伟形象被造的真理（创世记 1:27）表明，人类拥有一种机器无法复制的独特艺术能力。ARIA此举旨在“促进艺术的人性本质”，提醒我们珍惜和培养雅伟赋予我们的独特创造火花。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verse.textZh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。

title.en: Sharing dangerous driving videos is 'truly reprehensible', PM says
title.zh: 首相称分享危险驾驶视频“确实应受谴责”

summary.en: His comments come as the government urged TikTok and other social media firms to remove wrong-way driving videos.
summary.zh: 他的评论发表之际，政府敦促TikTok和其他社交媒体公司删除逆行驾驶视频。

body.en:
The government has urged social media companies to remove posts celebrating dangerous driving, as Prime Minister Andy Burnham branded sharing them "truly reprehensible".

Earlier Defence Minister Luke Pollard told BBC Breakfast that "social media companies could take the content down easily and adjust their algorithms to stop it being distributed".

Two police officers died when a car going the wrong way down a dual carriageway crashed into their vehicle near Middlesbrough on Saturday. Five passengers in the other car were also killed.

A TikTok account believed to belong to one of the five passengers, 18-year-old Makai Saddington, previously shared videos appearing to show dangerous driving, which have since been removed.

But Cleveland Police said "there is no evidence to indicate that filming of the activities that took place on Friday night and Saturday morning has taken place for the purposes of TikTok".

Pollard said the government had "already taken steps" to tell social media companies to take down such content.

He added: "They know exactly what content is on their site, they know how their algorithm works.

"They also know that people post content to get views and the more views you get, sometimes you get money for it, so it's a financial incentive to post outrageous content that gets more people watching it."

Speaking to reporters in Kyiv, Burnham said the people who share footage glorifying dangerous driving are "doing something that's truly reprehensible".

A Downing Street spokeswoman said "the glorification of dangerous driving for clips and entertainment is utterly disgraceful".

She added that the culture secretary has been clear that footage should be removed by social media platforms "in line with their legal obligations", and that Ofcom has the government's "full backing to take action" against those that fail in their duties.

Video content featuring illegal activity is not necessarily illegal itself - according to the Online Safety Act - it is up to the social network to decide whether flagged content is illegal and act accordingly.

TikTok said its policies prohibit content that could cause significant physical harm, including dangerous driving.

It added that it is actively removing videos and accounts that break its rules, including the account believed to belong to Saddington.

The company said between January and March 2026, 99.8% of the content removed for violating those policies it took down proactively.

While TikTok is taking some videos down, it is not necessarily because it has deemed them to be illegal - it may only be because they breach the firm's own terms and conditions.

There are specific exceptions which are set out in the Online Safety Act, but they can be difficult to interpret.

body.zh: 政府敦促社交媒体公司删除庆祝危险驾驶的帖子，总理安迪·伯纳姆称分享这些帖子“真正应受谴责”。 早些时候，国防部长卢克·波拉德 (Luke Pollard) 告诉 BBC 早餐会，“社交媒体公司可以轻松删除这些内容，并调整其算法以阻止其传播”。 周六，一辆在双车道上逆行的汽车在米德尔斯堡附近撞上了他们的车，两名警察死亡。另一辆车上的五名乘客也被杀。 据信，这五名乘客之一、18 岁的马凯·萨丁顿 (Makai Saddington) 的 TikTok 账户此前曾分享过看似危险驾驶的视频，但这些视频已被删除。 但克利夫兰警方表示，“没有证据表明周五晚上和周六早上发生的活动的拍摄是为了 TikTok 的目的”。 波拉德表示，政府“已经采取措施”要求社交媒体公司删除此类内容。 他补充道：“他们确切地知道他们网站上有什么内容，他们知道他们的算法是如何工作的。 “他们还知道，人们发布内容是为了获得观看次数，获得的观看次数越多，有时你就能获得金钱，因此发布令人震惊的内容以吸引更多人观看是一种经济激励。” 伯纳姆在基辅对记者表示，那些分享美化危险驾驶视频的人“正在做真正应受谴责的事情”。 唐宁街发言人表示，“为了剪辑和娱乐而美化危险驾驶是完全可耻的”。 她补充说，文化大臣已经明确表示，社交媒体平台应“根据其法律义务”删除视频，并且 Ofcom 得到政府“全力支持对那些不履行职责的人采取行动”。 具有非法活动的视频内容本身不一定是非法的 - 根据《在线安全法》 - 由社交网络决定标记的内容是否非法并采取相应行动。 TikTok 表示，其政策禁止可能造成严重人身伤害的内容，包括危险驾驶。 它补充说，它正在积极删除违反其规则的视频和帐户，包括据信属于萨丁顿的帐户。 该公司表示，2026 年 1 月至 3 月期间，99.8% 的内容因违反其主动删除的政策而被删除。 虽然 TikTok 下架了一些视频，但这并不一定是因为它认为这些视频非法，而可能只是因为它们违反了公司自己的条款和条件。 《在线安全法》中规定了一些特定的例外情况，但它们可能很难解释。 例如，内容...

title.en: Twitch and Amazon face legal action over using livestreams to train AI
title.zh: Twitch和亚马逊因使用直播内容训练人工智能而面临法律诉讼

summary.en: The lawsuit alleges Twitch used streamers' videos to train AI without their permission or proper compensation.
summary.zh: 该诉讼指控Twitch未经主播许可或未给予适当补偿，就使用他们的视频来训练人工智能。

body.en:
Amazon is facing a lawsuit , external over its move to train its AI models on videos people broadcast on the popular streaming platform Twitch.

The move faced backlash from users when it was announced in August - with people having the option to opt-out if they do not want their data used this way.

The class action lawsuit has been brought on behalf of millions of streamers who use Twitch, alleging its parent company Amazon used their videos to train AI without their permission or proper compensation.

Streamers on the platform reportedly produced , external more than 215 million hours of content in the first few months of 2026 alone.

It claims Twitch breached its contract with users by using that content as AI training data for Amazon's models without obtaining their permission.

It adds streamers should not have their work commercially exploited to develop AI without consent or compensation.

The lawsuit seeks damages for streamers whose content was allegedly used to train AI, as well as an order preventing Amazon from continuing the alleged practice.

It is not clear when Amazon began collecting Twitch users' data to train its AI models.

Twitch's chief product officer Mike Minton previously said he did not know if users' data had been scraped for training before it gave people the opportunity to opt-out.

He said he was unsure what Amazon "has done in terms of model training and what they've used and not used".

In Twitch's own FAQs about AI training, it said a person's audio might be used to "refine models that create speech to text".

It said this would help improve automatic subtitles on Twitch streams as well as Amazon videos.

Those that want to disable the feature would need to navigate to the Settings tab in their Streamer Dashboard, click the Security and Privacy tab, then scroll down to near the bottom of the options and toggle off "training for Generative AI".

However, the opt-out only applies to individual streams, meaning creators' content could still be used for AI training when they appear in a stream where the feature remains enabled.

Amazon, which bought Twitch for nearly $1bn (£740m) in 2014, has made AI a major focus as it competes with Google, Meta and other tech giants.

Sign up for our Tech Decoded newsletter to follow the world's top tech stories and trends. Outside the UK? Sign up here .
body.zh: 亚马逊因在流行的流媒体平台 Twitch 上播放的视频来训练其人工智能模型而面临外部诉讼。 此举在 8 月份宣布时遭到了用户的强烈反对，如果人们不希望自己的数据以这种方式使用，他们可以选择退出。 该集体诉讼是代表数百万使用 Twitch 的主播提起的，指控其母公司亚马逊在未经许可或适当补偿的情况下使用他们的视频来训练人工智能。 据报道，仅 2026 年前几个月，该平台上的流媒体就制作了超过 2.15 亿小时的内容。 它声称 Twitch 在未经用户许可的情况下将这些内容用作亚马逊模型的人工智能训练数据，违反了与用户的合同。 它还补充说，未经同意或补偿，主播不应将其作品用于商业用途以开发人工智能。 该诉讼要求对内容据称被用来训练人工智能的流媒体造成损害，并要求下令阻止亚马逊继续其所谓的做法。 目前尚不清楚亚马逊何时开始收集 Twitch 用户数据来训练其人工智能模型。 Twitch 的首席产品官迈克·明顿 (Mike Minton) 此前表示，他不知道用户的数据是否已被抓取用于培训，然后才给人们选择退出的机会。 他表示，他不确定亚马逊“在模型训练方面做了什么，以及他们使用了什么和没有使用什么”。 在 Twitch 自己的关于人工智能训练的常见问题解答中，它表示一个人的音频可能会被用来“完善创建语音到文本的模型”。 该公司表示，这将有助于改进 Twitch 流媒体和亚马逊视频的自动字幕。 想要禁用该功能的用户需要导航到 Streamer 仪表板中的“设置”选项卡，单击“安全和隐私”选项卡，然后向下滚动到选项底部附近并关闭“生成 AI 训练”。 然而，选择退出仅适用于单个流，这意味着当创作者的内容出现在该功能保持启用的流中时，仍然可以用于人工智能训练。 亚马逊于 2014 年以近 10 亿美元（7.4 亿英镑）的价格收购了 Twitch，在与谷歌、Meta 和其他科技巨头竞争时，已将人工智能作为主要焦点。 订阅我们的 Tech Decoded 时事通讯，了解世界顶级科技故事和趋势。在英国以外？在这里注册。

reflection.en: The lawsuit against Twitch and Amazon highlights a critical ethical question in the age of AI: how do we ensure fair compensation and consent when digital content is used to build new technologies? Jeremiah 22:13 reminds us of the ancient warning against building prosperity by exploiting others' labor without proper wages. As companies like Amazon leverage...
reflection.zh: Twitch和亚马逊面临的诉讼，提出了人工智能时代一个重要的伦理问题：当数字内容被用于开发新技术时，我们如何确保公平的补偿和同意？雅伟在耶利米书22:13中提醒我们，不要通过剥削他人的劳动而不支付适当的报酬来建立繁荣。当亚马逊等公司利用大量的用户生成内容来训练强大的人工智能模型时，公正地回报那些为这些财富做出贡献的人的劳动，这一原则仍然至关重要。

summary.en: The universally beloved tulips are synonymous with the Netherlands. The low-lying European country dominates the global market, producing nearly 90% of the world’s tulips. Every year, from March to May, tourists flock to tulip gardens and fields in the Dutch countryside to see...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自受造栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: The universally beloved tulips are synonymous with the Netherlands. The low-lying European country dominates the global market, producing nearly 90% of the world’s tulips. Every year, from March to May, tourists flock to tulip gardens and fields in the Dutch countryside to see the flowers in full bloom. The origins of Tulipa, however, are believed to lie elsewhere. A massive genetic analysis of wild tulips has confirmed that broader Central Asia is the birthplace of tulips, dating back roughly 32.5 million years. The researchers also traced the closest ancestors of the popular garden tulips down to two possible candidates. This study “is a foundational piece of our understanding of the [Tulipa] group,” study lead author Brett Wilson, co-founder of the IUCN SSC Wild Tulip Specialist Group, told Mongabay by email. “We now know — rather than assume — that tulips originated in Central Asia, and that urgent action is needed there if we are not going to lose a great many of these species.” Wilson, a botanist and conservationist whose Ph.D. research was focused on tulips at the University of Cambridge, U.K., spoke with Mongabay’s Shreya Dasgupta about the new study. The following interview has been edited for length and clarity. Botanist and conservationist Brett Wilson. Image courtesy of Brett Wilson. Mongabay: It’s been generally believed that tulips originated in Central Asia. Why is this study important now? Brett Wilson: Central Asia has always been the obvious suspect — it holds more wild tulip species than anywhere else on Earth…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 广受喜爱的郁金香是荷兰的代名词。这个地势低洼的欧洲国家在全球市场上占据主导地位，生产世界上近 90% 的郁金香。每年三月至五月，游客都会涌向荷兰乡村的郁金香花园和田野，观赏盛开的花朵。然而，郁金香的起源被认为在其他地方。对野生郁金香的大规模遗传分析证实，更广泛的中亚地区是郁金香的诞生地，其历史可以追溯到大约 3250 万年前。研究人员还追踪了流行的花园郁金香的最近祖先到两个可能的候选者。这项研究“是我们了解[郁金香]群体的基础，”该研究的主要作者、IUCN SSC 野生郁金香专家组的联合创始人 Brett Wilson 通过电子邮件告诉 Mongabay。 “我们现在知道——而不是假设——郁金香起源于中亚，如果我们不想失去大量这些物种，就需要在那里采取紧急行动。”威尔逊是一位植物学家和自然资源保护主义者，其博士学位。英国剑桥大学的研究重点是郁金香，他与 Mongabay 的 Shreya Dasgupta 讨论了这项新研究。为了篇幅和清晰度，以下采访经过编辑。植物学家和自然资源保护主义者布雷特·威尔逊。图片由布雷特·威尔逊提供。 Mongabay：人们普遍认为郁金香起源于中亚。为什么这项研究现在很重要？布雷特·威尔逊：中亚一直是明显的嫌疑人 - 它拥有比地球上其他任何地方都多的野生郁金香物种......本文最初发表于 Mongabay

title.en: Can big tech stop wildlife crime?
title.zh: 大科技能阻止野生动物犯罪吗？

summary.en: There’s a new, unlikely ally in the fight against illegal wildlife crime: Big tech. Earlier this year, new commitments from household names including Paypal, Meta, eBay and Etsy were announced at the United For Wildlife Business Forum to End Wildlife Trade. Wildlife trafficking...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自受造栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: There’s a new, unlikely ally in the fight against illegal wildlife crime: Big tech. Earlier this year, new commitments from household names including Paypal, Meta, eBay and Etsy were announced at the United For Wildlife Business Forum to End Wildlife Trade. Wildlife trafficking is a sophisticated international crime worth billions of dollars. As wildlife trade increasingly moves online, traffickers are using social media, e-commerce platforms and even cryptocurrency to operate across borders. The involvement of these organisations will be crucial in disrupting the networks behind wildlife crime and experts have welcomed these pledges but the question remains: will these new commitments be enough? Especially when some of the same technologies being enlisted to fight wildlife trafficking have also helped enable its growth, as shown by recent reports watchdog organizations.This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 在打击非法野生动物犯罪的斗争中，出现了一个不太可能的新盟友：大型科技公司。今年早些时候，Paypal、Meta、eBay 和 Etsy 等家喻户晓的公司在野生动物联盟商业论坛上宣布了终止野生动物贸易的新承诺。野生动物贩运是一种复杂的国际犯罪，价值数十亿美元。随着野生动物贸易越来越多地转移到网上，走私者正在利用社交媒体、电子商务平台甚至加密货币进行跨境运作。这些组织的参与对于破坏野生动物犯罪背后的网络至关重要，专家们对这些承诺表示欢迎，但问题仍然存在：这些新的承诺是否足够？特别是当一些用于打击野生动物贩运的相同技术也有助于促进其发展时，正如监管机构最近的报告所表明的那样。本文最初发表在 Mongabay 上
